convars.help:
This string is prefixed to the name of all bots that join the game.
<difficulty> will be replaced with the bot's difficulty.
<weaponclass> will be replaced with the bot's desired weapon class.
<skill> will be replaced with a 0-100 representation of the bot's skill.
convars.name: bot_prefix

convars.help: Draw fps meter at top of screen (1 = fps, 2 = smooth fps, 3 = server MS, 4 = Show FPS and Log to file )
convars.name: cl_showfps

convars.help: Prescale the clock by this amount.
convars.name: host_timescale

convars.help: Allows team members to injure other members of their team
convars.name: mp_friendlyfire

convars.help: max number of rounds to play before server changes maps
convars.name: mp_maxrounds

convars.help: CT Loadouts for default pistol round when playing bomb site retake.
convars.name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_default_pistol_round

convars.help: How many minutes each round takes.
convars.name: mp_roundtime

flags.description: Requires sv_cheats 1 to change; reset when cheats are disabled.
flags.name: cheat

flags.description: Can be forced from the command line; a command-line value locks out later changes.
flags.name: commandline_enforced

flags.description: Registered by the game server binary (server.dll).
flags.name: gamedll

flags.description: A change is announced to connected players (console/chat notification).
flags.name: notify

flags.description: Present in release/shipping builds, not just internal ones.
flags.name: release

flags.description: Server's value is sent to and enforced on connected clients.
flags.name: replicated
